title: Current Source Editor baseline
summary: The accepted source baseline is oorexx_source_editor_v0.1-dev5, SHA-256 7b72bdf6195d6b752c92ffe0831888b834de2323fa0a887bf8dfddc45191a440, qualified under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196. Dev4 added SourceFileMatch and SourceTreeFinder using RexxUtil SysFileTree; tree grep reuses SourceDocument and SourceFinder. Dev5 added SourceCompletionCandidate and SourceCompletionProvider with deterministic ordering and direct object APIs for document and tree completion. The CLI is a projection over those objects, not semantic authority.
invariants: Implementation remains native ooRexx; do not move semantic ownership into Python.
Literal find stays literal; regex grep uses ooRexx RegularExpression semantics.
Recursive file traversal uses ooRexx/RexxUtil facilities rather than an external find subprocess.
Source results retain original path/line/column and enclosing-symbol provenance where available.
User-visible completion order is deterministic and must not depend on Directory iteration order.
